assumptions_and_limits: All inputs are exact; no externally supplied numerical boundary values are used.
AMF and FT are distinct boundary/recursion routes but share Symbolica, native RustRed, arithmetic and continuation infrastructure. This is not an independent Mathematica oracle.
Each public fit validates with changed exact epsilon samples, increased working precision and series order. Working bits alone do not certify accuracy.
The reported20-digit criterion follows the public fitter: relative error for resolved nonzero coefficients, absolute error near numerical zero.
All outputs and observed sample counts are retained. Declared but unused refinement grids are not counted as evaluated.
This is numerical comparison/refinement evidence, not an interval enclosure of every final coefficient.
The standalone driver uses the frozen production library and native APIs without a manual peeling implementation.
Both processes use fresh isolated symbolic caches, singleCPU33 and explicit1800s/16GiB limits. Wall times are provenance, not a cross-package benchmark.
